thread:
Maria: Quick sync — need a concise GA assurance matrix for Predictor V2. Can we confirm SLA, docs, oncall, monitoring, and pricing signoff by EOD Friday? TL;DR: which items are blocking?

Kevin: @Maria I have the high-level SLA drafted (99.9% uptime SLO, P95 latency targets). Still missing the error budget policy and rollback-to-fallback mapping. ETA EOD Thursday.

Sasha: Docs status: skeleton + API examples done. Need the SDK curl+py snippets and one end-to-end tutorial. Will add examples with the new streaming shape.

Alon: Monitoring: dashboards are in staging for tok/sec, tail latency, and kv-cache hit rate. Alerting needs concrete thresholds — proposal: p95 > 350ms and error rate > 0.5% trigger page.

deploy-bot: smoke-check: staging -> production pipeline: all checks passed at 2026-03-20T14:02Z. Logs: `smoke: ok`, `latency: nominal` :white_check_mark:

Julian: Pricing: recommend tiered per-token pricing + burst credit. Commercial asked for a quick bill-of-materials for average request size and expected qps. I'll post numbers by tomorrow noon.

Maria: Owners recapped: SLA = Kevin, Docs = Sasha, Monitoring = Alon, Oncall/runbooks = Kevin + SRE, Pricing = Julian. Action: each owner post a single-line status update: "ready" or "blocker + short reason" + ETA. I'll compile into the launch checklist.

Kevin: SLA: blocker — need final approval for rollback policies from eng leads. ETA: 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC.

Sasha: Docs: ready-ish — need one more example. ETA: 2026-03-24 12:00 UTC. Posting PRs to docs repo momentarily.

Alon: Monitoring: ready for canary, but threshold tuning pending 24h burn. ETA: 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC.

Julian: Pricing: ready for internal review. blocker — legal wants pricing guardrails for enterprise discounts. ETA: 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC.

Maria: Notes:
- If SLA rollback mapping is unresolved, we should default to fast-fallback to smaller quantized model for 1 hour.
- Oncall runbook: need specific play for KV cache corruption (paging steps + diag command).
- Docs must include billing example (token math) and a sample invoice line.

Sasha: Adding billing example now. Example snippet:
```
# estimate tokens
avg_tokens = 340
price_per_1k = 0.0025
cost_per_call = avg_tokens/1000 * price_per_1k
```

Maria: OK — if you hit exec blockers or anything with legal/commercial, flag with :rotating_light: and I'll escalate. Otherwise we'll collate and aim for a readiness sync Friday 1600 UTC.

Kevin: Acknowledged.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release freeze windows apply on GA. See `#eng-releases` pinned note.

Maria: Thanks team — post updates in this thread and I'll assemble the one-pager for the launch forum.
